parsed.summary: The PR adds get/set_antialiased methods to Text objects, but there are concerns about maintainability and potential regressions.

issues.description: The changes introduce new methods and attributes to Text objects, which could increase the complexity and maintenance burden of the codebase.
There is a risk that the changes could break existing behavior, particularly for users who rely on the global rcParams['text.antialiased'] setting for Text objects.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify the functionality of the get/set_antialiased methods, which could lead to undetected regressions in the future.
